limitations: Only the exact 20 assigned units are reviewed in this process; no whole-book completion.
548 pre-existing missing commentaries outside scope prevent full shared build and strict validation from passing.
Three primary judgments selectively researched. No exhaustive case-law coverage; other authorities mentioned by those judgments are not independently verified.

Current external Sv execution, medical-data and forensic-care procedures are not exhaustively described. Statutory references are preserved and commentary is confined to verified code text and precise holdings.
Historical bodies are not concatenated; the 2013 and 2020 judgments use old numbering that is explicitly distinguished from current provisions.
Technical content agreement, minimum length and repetition checks do not establish legal quality or external professional approval.
